name: Blue Cheese
siboNotes: Blue cheese is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's naturally FODMAP-free and aged, making it easier to digest than fresh dairy.
preparationTips: Store properly wrapped in refrigerator to maintain freshness
Allow to come to room temperature before serving for best flavor
Crumble just before use to prevent drying out
Pair with low-FODMAP fruits like grapes or strawberries
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
Contains beneficial probiotics from aging process
